2) Rollback credits for obviously linked accounts (we can scope via email-hash prefix + device fingerprint).

Raw telemetry notes:
- KV cache traces show identical prefix hits for 91% of sample; suggests scripted reuse of the same prompt template/seed.
- Token consumption pattern matches prior abuse case (20250720 pattern).
- I ran a conservative block against the /self-serve/grant endpoint for the implicated IP block; results: grant issuance dropped to baseline.

Proposed hotfix (applied to staging):
1) require email MX validation + domain allowlist check for first 24h for new accounts requesting grants.
2) fold in device-fingerprint throttle (block if canvas_hash hits threshold > 20 in 10m).
3) attach a soft flag to accounts from suspect domains and route to manual review before granting.

Attachment: trial_grant_rules.patch (diff of gating logic).
